# Second Site Review 2026-09-30

The meeting where I meant to decide on unit 7 at Saltings Market Hall and did not. Held at Hollowgate after closing, 16:30-18:45, with [[ruth-marchbank]], [[kofi-asare]] and [[lena-marsh]]. [[margot-elling]] was invited and could not come.

## At a Glance

> [!note]
> Decision deferred to 2026-12-15, four days before the unit 7 option expires on 2026-12-19. Two conditions must move first: a three-month cash buffer of about 95,000 EUR (41,000 EUR held) and a production plan that does not put the bakers on 03:00 starts.

## What Was On The Table

- The [[saltings-hall-feasibility]] results: base case breaks even in month 14, high case month 9, low case not within 36 months ([[saltings-hall-three-scenario-model]]).
- The Pellow Mutual offer of 2026-09-08: 85,000 EUR, five years, 7.9% ([[pellow-mutual-second-site-loan-offer]]).
- Fit-out and working capital of 120,000 EUR ([[saltings-unit-7-fit-out-budget]]).
- The forecast's second-site tab, low case ([[thirteen-week-cash-flow-forecast]]).

## Ruth's Advice

Ruth said the unit itself looks reasonable and the loan is priced fairly. Her objection is timing. In the low case, Hollowgate would be carrying the unit's losses through its first winter, and the forecast shows the end-of-week balance falling below our 15,000 EUR floor in January 2028. Her rule for a business with seasonal takings: hold three months of fixed costs and payroll in cash before expanding, about 95,000 EUR for us ([[cash-buffer-calculation-2026-09]]). We held 41,000 EUR in September. She would not count Christmas deposits as buffer because they are owed product.

I asked whether we could open with a smaller buffer if the loan were larger. Her answer: a bigger loan raises the monthly repayment from about 1,720 EUR and makes the low case worse, not better.

## Kofi's Objection

Kofi had seen the draft of [[central-production-kitchen]] and had sent his view by email the week before ([[kofi-email-on-central-production]]). He repeated it: baking unit 7's bread and viennoiserie from the Hollowgate basement on the current pattern means 03:00 starts for him and [[joel-whitcombe]], and he will not do that, nor ask Hana to. He reminded us that he averaged 47 hours a week in summer 2025 and that [[hana-kobayashi]] was hired to bring that under 42. He is not against a second site; he is against it being built on the early shift.

Lena backed him and added that front-of-house cover for a seven-day hall unit would stretch the rota she already finds tight on Saturdays.

## What I Decided

- No decision today. Deferred to 2026-12-15 ([[should-we-open-a-second-site]]).
- Before then: rerun the buffer projection with Christmas 2026 deposits on 2026-11-30; get a production pattern from the bakers themselves by 2026-11-16; ask Priscilla about extending the option; ask Devon whether the loan offer can be held.
- Nobody outside this room hears about the second site until December.

## Afterwards

I was more relieved than disappointed. Wrote [[baker-hours-limit-growth]] that evening, and followed up with Ruth on 2026-10-19 ([[notes-from-ruth-call-2026-10-19]]).
